`jxl-test.jxl` comes from the Apache-2.0/MIT-licensed jxl-oxide project and is
used to cover JPEG XL decoding and CMYK-to-sRGB color conversion.

Source: https://github.com/tirr-c/jxl-oxide/blob/main/crates/jxl-oxide-tests/tests/cms/cmyk_layers.jxl

`animated-jxl-test.jxl` is the cropped traffic-light animation from the
CC-BY-4.0-licensed libjxl testdata repository.

Source: https://github.com/libjxl/testdata/blob/main/jxl/blending/cropped_traffic_light.jxl
